heading: `regex`
text:
### `regex` [LCAP.2.8]

A construct capability. `regex: true` permits the whole regular-expression
surface: the `~` and `!~` match operators and regex literals
([LREG]). `regex: false` forbids all of them; [LNRE] specifies it
in full, and [LFCA.13.1] carries the refactor hint.

A runtime may be built without its RE2-class engine ([LCAP.1]). Such a
build refuses an artefact whose `requires` lists `regex`
([RDSC.16.2.7]).
